title: Near-death experiencers describe living buildings with doors that open like molten metal

tellings.quote: I've got a whole list of maybe 20 so far.

plain: People who have nearly died and come back describe seeing buildings that seem alive, with doors that open as if made of molten metal. The researcher Grant Cameron says he has been collecting such accounts and tells Michels, "I've got a whole list of maybe 20 so far." If the reports line up, they would suggest that people in those moments are seeing something shared rather than something private.
